turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hi, may I speak with James Smith? I need to verify your date of birth.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: This is James.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you. This is Dana with Apex Recovery. This is an attempt to collect a debt and any information obtained will be used for that purpose.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Okay, I can pay part of it this week.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Great, I appreciate that. Let's set up a promise to pay for Friday.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Listen, if you don't pay today we will have you arrested and garnish your wages.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: That sounds illegal.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Pay now or face a warrant.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, I'm calling about an account.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Please stop calling me, I don't want these calls.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: I understand, but you still owe the balance, can we set up payment?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: I said do not call me again.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hi, is this the wife of Robert Brown? Tell your husband he owes us money.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: He's not here.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Well let your husband know the balance is past due.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, this is Sam with Apex Recovery. Can you confirm your address? This is an attempt to collect a debt.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Yes that's me. Honestly this isn't my debt, I think it's wrong.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thank you for letting me know, I'll open a dispute and pause collection until it's validated.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hey, you've been ignoring us. You're a deadbeat and frankly irresponsible.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Wow, that's harassing.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Just pay it.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hello, I'm calling for an unpaid balance.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Who is this?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Just calling about money you owe, can you pay today?

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hi Maria, this is Lee with Apex Recovery. Can you verify your date of birth? This is an attempt to collect a debt and any information will be used for that purpose.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Sure. I'm happy to set something up.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Wonderful, thank you. Let's schedule a follow up and I'll send written confirmation.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: This is Apex Recovery regarding your account. Reply STOP to opt out.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: STOP

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: You have been unsubscribed.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Pat with Apex Recovery, this is an attempt to collect a debt. Can I confirm I'm speaking with the account holder?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Great, would you like to settle the balance today or set a payment plan?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: I'll pay the full amount now, thank you.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: If you don't pay we'll tell your boss and your neighbors about this debt.

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: You can't do that.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Watch me.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Good morning, Sam with Apex Recovery, this is an attempt to collect a debt. May I verify your date of birth?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Okay, go ahead.

turns.speaker: Agent
turns.text: Thanks. I appreciate your time. Shall we set up a plan that works for you?

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.text: Sounds good, thank you.
